content.text:
I submitted **index 3 (Sb fraction 0.305)** as the best composition. Its EQE was 0.029%, the highest of the five I measured. That is out of five EQE measurements and two of the five XRD scans.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.217 | −0.009 |
| **3** | **0.305** | **0.029** |
| 4 | 0.361 | 0.025 |
| 12 | 0.503 (Pb₂Sb₂O₇ composition) | 0.005 |
| 22 | 0.671 (PbSb₂O₆ composition) | 0.007 |

- **Where it peaks:** EQE is highest on the lead-rich side, between Sb fractions of about 0.30 and 0.36. It falls off sharply at the compositions of the two known ternary phases, and turns negative at 0.217.
- **Phase-matched guesses didn't pay off:** I started with those two phases because the predicted band gaps (about 2.5 and 2.7 eV) sit close to the 2.7 eV illumination. Both gave low EQE.
- **XRD:** At index 3 the pattern shows one main phase. At index 0 (Sb 0.195) the same phase appears with a few extra peaks, possibly lead oxide. I didn't run a pattern-matching check to confirm either phase.
- **Untested gap:** I didn't measure index 2 (Sb 0.268), between the negative result at 0.217 and the best at 0.305. The true peak could be there or elsewhere in 0.27–0.36. With no budget left, index 3 is the best I can submit.
